name: codeEditorPrimitive
title: Code Editor
description: Editor chrome with syntax-highlighted code and a filename tab. Compose when a code or config sample is the content.

code.description: Code snippet — literal "\n" sequences are expanded to real newlines

filename.description: Filename shown in the title bar (default "app.ts")

accent.description: Reserved brand accent (not used in the syntax palette today). Defaults to "#00e5a0".
